title: Somebody That I Used To Know

cues.text: Now and then I think of when we were together
cues.translation: 가끔은 우리가 함께였던 때를 떠올려

cues.text: Like when you said you felt so happy you could die
cues.translation: 네가 너무 행복해서 죽을 수도 있을 것 같다고 말하던 때처럼

cues.text: Told myself that you were right for me
cues.translation: 넌 내게 맞는 사람이라고 스스로 되뇌었어

cues.text: But felt so lonely in your company
cues.translation: 하지만 네 곁에 있으면 너무 외로웠어

cues.text: But that was love, and it's an ache I still remember
cues.translation: 그래도 그건 사랑이었고 아직도 기억나는 아픔이야

cues.text: You can get addicted to a certain kind of sadness
cues.translation: 사람은 어떤 슬픔엔 중독될 수도 있어

cues.text: Like resignation to the end, always the end
cues.translation: 끝을 받아들이는 것처럼 언제나 끝을

cues.text: So when we found that we could not make sense
cues.translation: 그래서 우리가 더는 말이 안 통한다는 걸 알았을 때

cues.text: Well, you said that we would still be friends
cues.translation: 그래도 우린 친구로 남을 거라고 네가 말했지

cues.text: But I'll admit that I was glad it was over
cues.translation: 하지만 끝나서 다행이었다고 난 인정할게

cues.text: But you didn't have to cut me off
cues.translation: 하지만 날 그렇게 끊어낼 필요는 없었어

cues.text: Make out like it never happened and that we were nothing
cues.translation: 아무 일도 없었던 듯 우린 아무것도 아닌 척

cues.text: And I don't even need your love
cues.translation: 난 네 사랑조차 필요 없는데

cues.text: But you treat me like a stranger, and that feels so rough
cues.translation: 낯선 사람처럼 날 대하니 너무 힘들어

cues.text: No, you didn't have to stoop so low
cues.translation: 아니 그렇게까지 비열할 필요는 없었어

cues.text: Have your friends collect your records and then change your number
cues.translation: 친구들을 시켜 네 음반을 챙겨 가고 번호까지 바꿨잖아

cues.text: I guess that I don't need that, though
cues.translation: 그래도 난 그런 건 필요 없나 봐

cues.text: Now you're just somebody that I used to know
cues.translation: 이제 넌 그저 내가 알던 사람이야

cues.text: Now you're just somebody that I used to know
cues.translation: 이제 넌 그저 내가 알던 사람이야

cues.text: Now and then I think of all the times you screwed me over
cues.translation: 가끔은 네가 날 이용해 먹던 모든 때를 떠올려

cues.text: But had me believing it was always something that I'd done
cues.translation: 하지만 언제나 내가 잘못한 일이라고 믿게 만들었지

cues.text: And I don't wanna live that way
cues.translation: 난 더는 그렇게 살고 싶지 않아

cues.text: Reading into every word you say
cues.translation: 네가 하는 말 하나하나에 의미를 부여하며

cues.text: You said that you could let it go
cues.translation: 넌 놓아줄 수 있다고 말했지

cues.text: And I wouldn't catch you hung up on somebody that you used to know
cues.translation: 내가 네가 한때 알던 사람을 못 잊는 걸 보게 되진 않을 거라고

cues.text: But you didn't have to cut me off
cues.translation: 하지만 날 그렇게 끊어낼 필요는 없었어

cues.text: Make out like it never happened and that we were nothing (aah-ooh)
cues.translation: 아무 일도 없었던 듯 우린 아무것도 아닌 척 아아 우

cues.text: And I don't even need your love (ooh)

cues.translation: 아니 그렇게까지 비열할 필요는 없었어 우

cues.translation: 친구들을 시켜 네 음반을 챙겨 가고 번호까지 바꿨잖아 아아
